name: Taffytwirl
subtitle: Pull taffy, match the stripes
shortDescription: Stretch, fold and swirl glossy pulled taffy until the stripes match the customer's order: 132 candy-shop puzzles in real 3D.
longDescription:
A customer wants a taffy pull in a very particular order of stripes. You have a long, glossy strand, a marble counter and a handful of folding tricks. Stretch it, fold it, and make the stripes line up.

Taffytwirl is a calm candy-shop puzzle in real 3D. Every order shows the stripe pattern the customer wants. Pull the taffy to one side and let go to fold it with the tool you have picked, or tap the strand for the quick fold. The stripes rewrite themselves in the way that tool works, and the glossy taffy stretches, snaps back and swirls as you go. Undo and restart are free, so you can think out loud.

### Eight Fold Tools, Each With Its Own Rule
- Hook folds the strand back onto itself, mirrored.
- Echo repeats the whole strand.
- Braid weaves the stripes together from both ends.
- Snip keeps the first half and bites off the rest.
- Twist rolls the first stripe round to the back.
- Swap trades the two ends.
- Dye turns every stripe into the next flavour.
- Cut keeps exactly as many stripes as you pull, so how far you pull matters.
New tools arrive world by world, and from the Twist Lane onward some tools have a limited number of uses per order, so the order in which you fold becomes the puzzle.

### 132 Orders In Six Shop Worlds
Sugar Counter, Snip Alley, Twist Lane, Swap Shop, Dye House and the Grand Confectionery, 22 orders each. The last order of every world is a two-tier wedding cake: finish the bottom tier, and the top tier starts from the taffy you just made. Every order is checked by a solver, so there is always an answer, and the star target is the true shortest number of folds.

### A Shop That Grows With You
Each order comes with a customer and a small story. Every cleared order adds a swirl to your Swirl Album, shiny from Common up to Legendary according to your stars (no random loot, no boxes). Earn Sugar Coins by playing and spend them in the Shop on twelve decorations that appear on your counter: bunting, a jar shelf, a brass scale, a neon sign, a shop cat and more.

### Every Day, And Endlessly
A fresh Daily Order, the same for everyone, with a streak. An endless Candy Shop that keeps handing you new orders. A short Watch and Learn lesson at the start. No lives, no timers, nothing is ever unwinnable. Plays offline, no account.
whatsNew: Version 1.0 launch: 132 orders in six shop worlds, eight fold tools, two-tier wedding-cake bosses, a Swirl Album and a Daily Order.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
